NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location centres the map on you, finds the outings and discussions around, and confirms your presence on the day of an outing. It is never shown to others.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: In the background, askandgo only looks at your location in the 24 hours before an outing you joined, to confirm your arrival without you opening the app.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: In the background, askandgo only looks at your location in the 24 hours before an outing you joined, to confirm your arrival without you opening the app.
NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is only used to scan QR codes (presence, contacts). No photo is taken.
